content.rendered:
?

Psalms 23:5 MSG
You serve me a six-course dinner ? right in front of my enemies. You revive my drooping head; my cup ? brims with blessing.
?
This is awesome.

✔Your antagonists are present.
✔Those who said you will not reach your goal were not left out.
✔Those who said you will never marry, let alone conceived were also brought in there.
✔Those who said “over my dead body” will you ever get that promotion were also amongst the watching crowd.

??Before their very eyes, God will take you there while they watch helplessly.

Yes, this is what will happen as narrated by Exodus 15:16 KJV
Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O Lord , till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

????O yes, they will all be watching even as Gods goodness is being lavished upon you.

Your head will be lifted up again & the cup of your blessings will run over in Jesus name????
????????
